ears_text: When a project builds a Python wheel, the wheel's file name shall carry the project's version, in the form <name>-<version>-<tags>.whl, so that the package index can publish it without the version being supplied separately.
notes: Static check that every py_wheel declares a version, plus a check of any wheel already under dist/ or bazel-bin/. Skips when a project has neither. Suggested gate point: package_publish.
